ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  3i Infotech Limited has secured a three-year contract valued at approximately Rs. 5.33 crores to provide IT Management Services to a new, state-owned power distribution utility in India, commencing November 1, 2026. This domestic deal expands their client base and provides a recurring revenue stream by supporting critical client infrastructure. However, the company voluntarily disclosed it, noting the contract value is below its materiality threshold, suggesting a positive strategic step but a limited individual financial impact on overall performance.
